name: af3_submit_prediction
description: Submit AlphaFold 3 all-atom structure prediction to Agent Platform Prediction Endpoint. Supports proteins, RNA, DNA, ligands, and ions in --msa-free zero-MSA mode or with custom MSA inputs.

input.description: Input sequence in FASTA format, AF3 JSON format, or path to input file / GCS URI. FASTA is automatically converted to AF3 JSON format.

msa_free.description: Whether to run in zero-MSA / --msa-free mode, bypassing Jackhmmer/genetic database searches for fast candidate screening (default: true).

endpoint_id.description: Optional Agent Platform Endpoint ID override.

name: af3_check_endpoint
description: Inspect health, active deployment status, hardware configuration, and cost state of the AlphaFold 3 Agent Platform Endpoint.

endpoint_id.description: Optional Agent Platform Endpoint ID override.

name: af3_deploy_endpoint
description: Deploy AlphaFold 3 model to the Agent Platform Endpoint, allocating dedicated GPU resources (e.g. g2-standard-16 + L4 GPU) for prediction campaigns.

model_id.description: Optional Agent Platform Model resource name or ID (defaults to AF3_MODEL_ID).

endpoint_id.description: Optional Agent Platform Endpoint ID override.

sync.description: Whether to wait synchronously for deployment completion (~5-8 mins; default: false).

name: af3_undeploy_endpoint
description: Undeploy models from the AlphaFold 3 Agent Platform Endpoint, releasing GPU hardware and immediately reverting idle cost to $0.00/hr.

deployed_model_id.description: Optional specific deployed model ID to undeploy. If omitted, undeploys all models.

endpoint_id.description: Optional Agent Platform Endpoint ID override.

sync.description: Whether to wait synchronously for undeployment completion (default: true).

name: af3_get_results
description: Retrieve AlphaFold 3 prediction results from GCS. Returns ranking_score, pTM, ipTM, mean pLDDT, and mmCIF structure path.

name: af3_open_viewer
description: Open the FoldRun 3D structure viewer for AlphaFold 3 predictions. Renders all-atom mmCIF structure with pLDDT coloring and ligand visualization.
